Interface ProgressListener

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ProgressListener
Interface for progress bar or other progress display.
Author:
Lee A. Christie

    • onNewStage

      default void onNewStage(String description)
      Called to indicate the start of a stage of loading. If there is only one stage, then this will only be called once, at the start. If there are multiple stages, this will be called at the start of each stage.
      Parameters:
      description - the description of the stage of loading, not null

    • onUpdateProgress

      void onUpdateProgress(double progress)
      Called to update the progress.
      Parameters:
      progress - the progress in the current loading stage [0.0, 1.0]

    • onCompletion

      default void onCompletion()
      Called when all loading is complete and the progress indicator is no longer needed.

    • setCancelAction

      default void setCancelAction(Runnable action)
      Updates the action to be performed by the cancel button, if there is one. If there is no cancel button, this does nothing. null can be used to indicate no-operation.
      Parameters:
      action - the cancel action
